 UIDAI Facilitates Easier Access to Aadhaar Services at Aadhaar Seva Kendra in Chandigarh
 November 17, 2026 04:17 PM 
 Chandigarh, 17.11.26-: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Regional Office Chandigarh, is facilitating convenient access to Aadhaar services through its Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK) at SCO 57–59, Sector 17-A, Chandigarh. Chandigarh currently has one ASK, serving residents of the city as well as people from adjoining areas of Punjab and Haryana. 
 The Kendra provides an additional access point where residents can avail themselves of routine Aadhaar services, subject to service availability and UIDAI guidelines. The facility aims to improve accessibility and reduce unnecessary visits to the UIDAI Regional Office, Chandigarh. 
 Services available include new Aadhaar enrolment, demographic updates such as changes in name, address, date of birth and gender, biometric updates and other services permitted under UIDAI guidelines. New Aadhaar enrolment is free of cost. Charges for other services, wherever applicable, are as prescribed by UIDAI. 
 The Kendra aims to provide an accessible, inclusive and comfortable environment for people of all age groups, including children, senior citizens and persons with disabilities. Residents may also avail themselves of services at other Aadhaar enrolment and update centres convenient to them. 
 Citizens who specifically require a visit to the UIDAI Regional Office, Chandigarh, are advised to book an appointment 10 to 15 days in advance through https://sewa.uidai.gov.in⁠￼. Advance booking will help residents plan their visits and facilitate orderly service delivery. 
 UIDAI Regional Office Chandigarh reiterates its commitment to citizen-centric service delivery, with a focus on accessibility, inclusivity and convenience, enabling residents to access routine Aadhaar services while avoiding unnecessary travel to the Regional Office
